summary.intent: Resolve open PR review comments on PR #416, then merge and update all project documentation (DEFERRED.md, FEATURES.md, README.md, docs/ folder, ROADMAP.md) to reflect phases 28-37 changes on a dedicated docs branch.
summary.outcome: PR #416 merged after fixing encrypt-worker error handling and a doc comment. Docs branch PR #419 created with comprehensive updates: DEFERRED.md pruned of stale/implemented items, FEATURES.md updated with new features, README.md refreshed, new FILESYSTEM_SPECIFICATION.md created, and all docs/ files audited and updated for phases 28-37.

repo: Grafana Faro (apps/web/src/lib/faro.ts) is the production error tracking and remote log shipping solution — replaces any Sentry/Datadog/Loki references in docs.
Session replay is explicitly out of scope as an anti-feature for a privacy-first zero-knowledge product.
RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS is operator-level config, not end-user configurable — user-configurable retention is still deferred.
Desktop FUSE components are intentionally not unit tested; they are integration-tested via the Desktop E2E suite, as unit testing would require mocking too much of the host OS.
Linux FUSE is fully implemented under the same 'fuse' feature flag as macOS (libfuse3), giving NFC normalization and case-sensitive lookups.

The @cipherbox/crypto package has @cipherbox/core as a devDependency only for one test file (vault-ipns.test.ts) that verifies key domain separation — a leftover from Phase 19.1 restructuring that was never cleaned up.
folder.service.ts (1,059 lines, 9 importers) and bin.service.ts (971 lines, 2 functions actually used) are the remaining deprecated web services to be retired in Phase 38.
Database has grown to 14 tables; share_invites and pin_migrations were added in phases 28-37 and were missing from DATABASE_EVOLUTION_PROTOCOL.md.
TEE is now Phala Cloud CVM, not AWS Nitro (which was a planned fallback).
IPNS republish interval is 6h, not 3h — CLAUDE.md had a stale value.
The CipherBox FUSE mount is accessible via terminal on macOS and via PowerShell and Git Bash on Windows.
Preliminary R&D docs moved from 00-Preliminary-R&D/ to .planning/milestones/m0/ during a recent reorganization.

code.finding: postMessage/getWorker calls could throw, leaking pending map entries — fixed with try/catch that cleans up the pending entry on error.
uploadFiles() doc comment overstated memory bounding — fixed to clarify actual memory behavior.

Only file in @cipherbox/crypto that imports @cipherbox/core — creates a circular devDependency. Should be refactored to use hardcoded test vectors or moved to a cross-package integration test directory.

workflow: When asked to prune a list, do a systematic per-item verification pass — not just spot-checking items raised by the user. Shallow passes leave stale items that the user must find manually.
GraphQL resolve mutation and REST reply-to-comment are separate operations when closing PR review threads via gh CLI.

Pre-existing integration test failures (requiring live backend) can be distinguished from unit test failures by checking test file names (integration.test.ts) before concluding a test suite is broken.
When removing deferred items, check both the deferred doc and CONCERNS.md — they can contain related but separate entries for the same issue.

friction: Multiple rounds of user correction needed on DEFERRED.md — the initial pruning pass was shallow and missed already-implemented items (Grafana Faro, Linux FUSE, vault v1 columns, pin:secondaryFailed events, etc.).
Edit tool reformatted markdown table whitespace after edits, making it harder to read the actual current file content and requiring a raw bash cat to see the real state.
gh CLI push required a retry (likely a transient remote error).
The DTS circular dependency was prematurely removed from DEFERRED.md, then had to be re-added when the user clarified it was intentionally deferred for Phase 38.
open_items: Phase 38: Retire folder.service.ts (1,059 lines, 9 importers) and bin.service.ts (971 lines), remove @cipherbox/crypto circular devDependency on @cipherbox/core by refactoring vault-ipns.test.ts.
Phase 39: User-configurable vault parameters — bin retention period (default 30 days), soft vs hard delete behavior, versioning defaults (max versions per file, version cooldown period).

useDropUpload.ts batch memory issue (lazy file reads) — architectural change requiring SDK API to accept File objects or read callbacks instead of Uint8Array; tracked as deferred Upload Pipeline item.
Sharing link expiry / revocation — still in deferred.
Passive IPFS node seeding for resilience — still in deferred.
Admin audit log export (CSV/JSON) — still in deferred.
Rate limiting on sharing endpoints — still in deferred.
